Framing mask prediction as sequence generation is appealing because it makes supervision feel more natural and unified, and pairing that with language-based reasoning for multimodal, time-dependent scenes seems especially promising. Still, I’m not convinced the same setup reliably helps once the problem demands stronger temporal consistency, cross-modal cues, or fine-grained disambiguation. The open question, for me, is whether instruction-based generation genuinely strengthens segmentation with deeper reasoning, or whether it mostly offers a cleaner interface while leaving core robustness issues largely untouched.
